# Vendored ksni 0.3.6

Fork of https://github.com/iovxw/ksni with Ayatana AppIndicator label support:

- `Tray::xayatana_label` / `xayatana_label_guide`
- D-Bus properties `XAyatanaLabel`, `XAyatanaLabelGuide`
- Signal `XAyatanaNewLabel`

Used so GNOME can show countdown text beside the icon without squashing a wide pixmap.
